title: Valence-Arousal Quadrant Plotter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Apply the valence-arousal model by placing a point on a two-axis valence/arousal grid and classifying which quadrant it falls into, demonstrating why expressions that land near each other on the grid — such as afraid and surprised, both high-arousal — are more likely to be visually confused.
